scope: Fail-closed Gate 1 diagnosis after packaged control, documented-grid reconstruction, model/input parity, force localization, official-raster recovery, direct mesh parity, pressure-corrector, and historical-lineage screens.

official_reproducibility_gap.packaged_tutorial: The unchanged OpenFOAM v2512 airFoil2D tutorial passed in 308 iterations but has 10720 cells, 78 wall faces, U=(25.75 3.62 0), nu=1e-5, and no forceCoeffs object.
official_reproducibility_gap.documented_validation: The page instead describes the NASA 897x257 grid, U=51.4815 m/s, nu=8.58e-6 m2/s, and alpha=0/10/15 degree comparisons.
official_reproducibility_gap.missing_artifact: The complete case and raw OpenFOAM result tables that generated the documentation plots are not present in the packaged tutorial or documentation Git history.

official_plot_recovery.conclusion: The official marker is consistent with NASA at raster resolution, while the reconstructed standard-SA result is outside the original force-agreement tolerance.

parallel_decomposition.conclusion: Twelve-rank Scotch decomposition is not dominant.

sa_input_and_definition_parity.conclusion: Correcting both explicit NASA/OpenFOAM SA parity differences improves drag by only 0.0000223172.

foundation_v4_lineage.caveat: This tests a community-reported version sensitivity; it does not claim the openfoam.com plot was generated by Foundation v4.

mesh_conversion.conclusion: Direct v2512 plot3dToFoam conversion and the generated mesh have identical topology and coordinate parity within conversion precision.

surface_force_localization.conclusion: The unresolved exact-standard-SA drag excess is predominantly pressure drag, not wall shear.

external_reproduction_evidence.finding: Multiple independent users attempted to reconstruct the same public validation case; reports include convergence difficulty and version-dependent disagreement, so the reproducibility gap is not unique to this project.

gate_decision.permitted_next_work: Obtain the original plot-generating case or raw OpenFOAM surface/force data. Stock SST may otherwise proceed only as an explicitly labelled relative diagnostic, not as a passed validation rung.
gate_decision.reason: All public inputs and the strongest recoverable numerical, implementation, execution, and mesh hypotheses have been tested without reproducing the official alpha-zero drag. Further blind tuning would weaken rather than strengthen a publishable validation claim.
